kids.chars: §0 L77: SCR-038/drawing-moved-dark, SCR-038/drawing-locked-dark, SCR-038/drawing-hidden-dark, SCR-038/drawing-deleted-dark, SCR-038/drawing-shared-dark

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: BQ ruling: RULED (comment 6585044844 on the BQ list 6582998807), folded in the spec; the strings stay PROPOSED (spec L44)

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: Not drawn — the text is binding (§0 L82): SCR-039/preset-menu-dark, SCR-038/preset-viewer-dark, SCR-038/preset-builtin-conflict-dark, SCR-038/range-converted-dark, SCR-038/delete-all-dark, SCR-038/clone-no-link-dark, SCR-038/vwap-anchor-dark

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: §8 L298: trigger "the drawing released after a move"; shows "the profile over the new times"; copy W-38; announcement W-38 once

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: the drawing dragged 2 bars later and released: Rectangle 13:40 → 14:05 -> Rectangle 13:50 → 14:15; the profile kept its last state during the drag and recomputed once on release over the new times (14:978); a price-only move would not recompute (§4.3)

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: kit reading: E14's label is type + anchor (D02E14 L372), so the name in W-33 / W-38 follows the moved times

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: §8 L299: trigger "the drawing locked"; shows "the profile still; E14's lock glyph"; copy W-33; announcement none

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: locked: E14's lock glyph at the first anchor; the drawing stays selectable for inspection, never moved (D02E14 L283, L291); the profile stays still with it; no announcement here (§4.3)

value-2.chars: §8 L300: trigger "the drawing hidden"; shows "the profile kept; the legend W-34"; copy W-34; announcement none

value-3.chars: hidden: the drawing is not drawn (its tree row is the way to it, D02E14 L283); the profile is kept and still drawn; the legend reads W-34; E14 announces the hide, this flow adds none (§4.3); shown again, the legend returns to W-33

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: §8 L301: trigger "the drawing deleted"; shows "a Fixed range at the last times; E14's one toast with the profile line"; copy W-35; announcement W-35 once

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: the drawing deleted (Del): the profile is converted — never removed, never blocked by a confirmation — to a Fixed range at the drawing's last two times 13:40 → 14:05; the link is gone (§4.4)

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: one toast, never a second: E14's own copy with the profile line W-35 added (D04-A4); E14's lifetime and Undo, and E14's announcement gains the line once; E14's one Ctrl+Z does the same, so the timed toast is never the only path

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: Undo (or Ctrl+Z) re-creates the drawing under a new id: the undone drawing comes back unlinked and the profile stays the Fixed range of the conversion until a re-link exists (D04-G5; §2.7)

kids.name: value-6
kids.chars: kit reading: the drawing is a this-pane-only one, so E14's local form "removed from this pane." stands

kids.name: value-7
kids.chars: observability: profile.period_changed once for the conversion (§10; PROPOSED)

value-2.chars: §8 L302: trigger "the drawing moved in a synced pane"; shows "both panes; the profile follows"; copy W-38; announcement W-38 once

value-3.chars: two BTCUSDT panes in one layout: the drawing (one stable id, 26:328) is shared symbol-wide by every pane showing the symbol, not by sync group (D07E14 L260); it was moved in pane B to Rectangle 13:50 → 14:15 (cursor move)

value-4.chars: pane A's profile instance, attached to it, follows: a Fixed range over the new times; a "this pane only" drawing would drive only its own pane's instance; a Clone carries no link (§4.5; D04-C4)

value-5.chars: kit layout: pane A (top) holds the docked profile panel, pane B (bottom) the chart alone; both 5m

readings: R-K2: a range's legend words are its two times joined as W-26 joins them, "{start} to {end} UTC" (R-2, R-7); {start} / {end} fill as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM and the deck's own "UTC" closes the pair, so a sentence never reads "UTC UTC"

R-K4: CMP-045's stack is drawn at the window's lower right, 8 px above the status bar, over the docked panel's legend controls — never over the chart's plot stop, an edge handle or the Presets button (§2.6)
fallbacks: size.icon.sm (12 px) is a Tier-1 primitive (validator WARN), used for small glyphs
kit stand-in: the link glyph (§4.2) is not in the local icon set; it is drawn as two interlocked 7 × 5 px rings stroked 1 px in color.text.secondary beside W-33 (the words carry the state, R-2)

E14's handle language (§11): a color.text.primary dot in a color.border.strong ring, the glyph 8 px (D02E14 L287), its 24 × 24 target drawn only as a dashed board-marker outline where the target matters

kit choice: the terminal's TopBar and StatusBar are neutral placeholders (E10's, not this spec's); the bound chart is a plain SCR-030 price pane (candles, grid, price axis); its status row draws only the chips these flows touch (the tool chip, the feed chip on the stale frame) — no environment badge or control anywhere (R-1, C-2.11)
kit choice: a string a screen reader hears (an accessible name, a polite announcement) is drawn for the board as caption text in a bordered 'visually hidden' box (not on screen in the product)
elevation.3 is a Tier-1 primitive (validator WARN): the delete toast's binding as D07E14 L299 names it

kit stand-in: a CSS cursor (§5's keywords) is drawn as a small shape (crosshair: two 1 px strokes; ew-resize / ns-resize: a bar with two end ticks; grab / grabbing / move / pointer / default: a 10 px glyph box) with its keyword beside it in type.num.sm — the shape is a board marker, the keyword binds
